analysis.insight_summary: A user requested assistance in finding a compatible spare module for the discontinued [article_no]. The replies identified the original product type and proposed a replacement [product_name], plus sources for detailed technical information. The main issue identified is insufficient guidance on choosing successor products when older modules are phased out.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects a clear suggestion for a suitable replacement of the discontinued module, along with technical specifications to assess compatibility.
